notes: v0.19.0: Quest-native VRChat toolkit accessible ONLY on Meta Quest from the existing Main Companion Home, Explore and Settings. Home/Social/OSC/Tools screens reuse all existing Mini-VRCX pages including profiles, friends, online-pinned reordering, inbox/invites, private notes, bookmarks, world/group browsing, search, activity, verification, official rank-locked chatboxes, quick phrases and avatar parameters. New overlay-free Quest foreground OSC service offers explicit start/stop/pause of Live Chatbox and experimental PTT hold/release with five-minute timeout, permanent notification and emergency release. Ordinary Android phone navigation and floating overlay remain unchanged; Quest floater is still off by default. Quest log capture and in-game OSC reception still depend on device/VRChat behavior. No Relay/Main Launcher changes.
